summary_en: 1,500,000 shares (4.4% S/O) upper limit, ¥2,000M upper limit, open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange, 2026/08/04–2026/09/30. Financing via sale of investment securities and on-hand funds. Purpose: reduce policy holdings, optimize capital structure, advance ROE target to 15%+.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Scroll Corporation's board of directors on 31 July 2026 authorized the acquisition of up to 1,500,000 treasury shares (4.4% of 33,993,973 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥2,000 million. Execution window is 4 August to 30 September 2026 via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company intends to finance the acquisition through sale of investment securities and available cash. The stated rationale is to reduce policy holdings in line with Corporate Governance Code principles, optimize capital structure for the medium to long term, and accelerate achievement of the company's target ROE of 15% or above.
